exactOriginalDecisionText: D1 Positioning Direction Lock — DIRECTION LOCKED (not a final tagline). Positioning territory: hotel dealmaking in plain owner language. Working expression (NOT a tagline): Dealality helps hotel owners make and manage better hotel deals. Messaging law: clear first, stakes second, product third. Urgency: from real consequence, not hype. Product-specific urgency is allowed and expected. Provenance: preserve. Do not over-generalize claims. Explicit non-claims: This does not declare a final company tagline; does not approve website copy; does not retire the card triad (ONE HOTEL / BETTER DECISIONS / MORE VALUE); does not convert “Hotel Ownership Intelligence” into an approved public category phrase.
exactClarificationAddendum: CLARIFICATION ADDENDUM (2026-09-07) — does not replace the original lock: 1. “Hotel dealmaking” means the owner’s process of evaluating, structuring, comparing and managing important hotel decisions and counterparties. 2. It does NOT mean: hotel brokerage; hotel property sales; transaction intermediation; OTA/distribution; sales engine; public deal listing marketplace. 3. Product-specific messaging may address adjacent owner problems such as AI Demand Positioning when those problems affect a hotel’s commercial position or owner decision-making. 4. ADP does not change the company-level positioning territory into “AI company” or “AI marketing platform.” 5. Continue to apply: CLEAR FIRST → STAKES SECOND → PRODUCT THIRD. 6. The exact public tagline/category phrase remains TESTING / OPEN and is not being locked here.
